ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High; characterized by a dominant high-intensity white surface (estimated >85% of visible area) against a low-intensity black border along the trailing edge and central notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white contiguous field; high-contrast black band along the trailing edge margin; three distinct dark focal spots located in the mid-right lobe and one smaller spot near the central notch region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; approximate interior pixel angle of 65-75 degrees; significant depth relative to the horizontal axis of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the entire boundary; irregular peak-to-valley amplitudes with more pronounced, jagged protrusions on the outer quarters of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature from the notch to the mid-lobe, transitioning to a slightly more linear trajectory toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, multi-colored (white, yellow, tan) elevated textures localized exclusively at the distal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned grey-to-black linear disruptions; one prominent diagonal mark on the lower-left lobe and multiple short, horizontal scratches on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy calcified biological growth at the lobe extremities; small circular dark pigmentation anomalies (potential scars) clustered near the central notch.
other_distinctive_markers: The black pigmentation on the trailing edge thickens significantly as it approaches the central notch, creating a distinct triangular dark region.
